messages:
maria: quick postmortem follow-up: ETL lag on 2026-03-12 led to delayed spans and bad aggregation joins. we need owners, ETAs, and verification steps.

ajay: I can own detection/dashboard. will add rolling ETL latency + missing-span counter to canary dashboard. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

dave: I'll take the pipeline fix. root cause looks like windowing regression after reorder PR. plan: revert in staging, add ordering integration test, run targeted backfill for 03/12-03/14. ETA: Wed COB.

sasha: I'll own alerts and CI gating. adding Prometheus alert median_etl_processing_ms > 120s (5m) and a synthetic postdeploy span-count check. will gate the integration test in CI. ETA: Tue AM.

observability-bot: Incident summary posted: https://redwood.internal/pms/ETL-2026-03-12 — span-drop-rate spike x3.

maria: please add PR links and a short runbook entry for oncall triage. also flag recurring pattern: similar issue ~6-8 weeks after ordering-affecting deploys.

ajay: Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/infr/mon/pulls/412 — includes SQL to surface problematic batches.

dave: Backfill PR: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/389. staging revert commit fe12a. noted offending reorder change.

sasha: CI gating PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/77 — synthetic job + postdeploy validation. runbook snippet: "If span-drop spike -> pause deploys, trigger backfill job, notify #incidents and oncall."

maria: ownership recap: Ajay (detection) EOD tomorrow; Dave (pipeline + backfill) Wed COB; Sasha (alerts + CI) Tue AM. Ops: add runbook link to postmortem doc.

ajay: I'll add unique_service_span_ratio per deploy to canary.

dave: created followups checklist in postmortem doc: https://redwood.docs/pm/etl-2026-03-12/followups with owners/due dates.

maria: scheduling 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress. if blocked ping me and tag @sasha or @ajay.

sasha: ack. I'll also run a weekly regression query for 8 weeks; 2 recurrences -> escalate to rollout freeze.

maria: thanks team — we'll close when dashboards merged, backfill completes, CI gating live, and runbook in place. I'll post final signoff here. :white_check_mark:
